sources.title: Memory-Bound Inference: Optimizing vLLM for Production LLMs on Cloud ...
sources.snippet: Proprietary data constraints force self-hosting. This guide dissects the memory bandwidth bottlenecks of serving Llama 3 and Mistral via vLLM. We demonstrate how FP8 quantization and custom attention kernels overcome KV-cache eviction, achieving 3.8x. Tagged with aisystems, deepresearch, systemsarchitecture, benchmarks.
